hero-olas.papel: Héroe principal con espacio negativo para la disponibilidad.

Un parque acuático compacto y realista tiene una piscina poco profunda, dos toboganes bajos rectos y sombrillas lisas cerradas; detrás se ven calles ordenadas con pinos jóvenes y bungalows discretos. Agua azul clara, pavimento seguro y espacio negativo amplio a la izquierda para texto. Ninguna persona, texto, logotipo, matrícula, marca, resort de lujo, palmeras tropicales, piscina infinita, barco, ballena decorativa, HDR ni saturación excesiva.

vida-llegada.papel: H2 · vida: una familia deja libre el circuito de llegada y usa un carro.
vida-llegada.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping La Ballena demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of a family completing an orderly Saturday arrival at a large Mediterranean family campsite.
Input images: hero-sabado.webp and bungalow-ola.webp define the exact one-storey reception, teal-and-sand palette, young pines, realistic luggage carts, shared lanes and modest bungalow architecture.
Scene/backdrop: In a clearly marked but textless short-stay bay beside reception, two adults and two school-age children transfer four ordinary bags from a generic parked family car into one plain luggage cart; the car doors are closed and the vehicle remains fully inside the bay. The through-lane behind is completely clear.
Subject: Exactly four family members; one adult pushes the loaded cart, the other checks the closed tailgate, and both children carry one small personal item each. Natural action, no camera gaze.
Style/medium: Natural 35 mm editorial documentary photography, clean Saturday morning light, restrained teal, sand and pine-green palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2; clear bay, cart and open circulation dominate; family central for mobile crop.
Constraints: Plausible hands, cart wheels, bags, car doors and shadows; no readable signs or license plate.
Avoid: traffic queue, open car door into lane, running children, luxury luggage, logos, readable text, malformed limbs, resort glamour, HDR, watermark.
